name: Manchones (Spain)
description: Red field with wavy stripes of blue and yellow along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with a yellow shrine.
history: Municipal flag of Manchones; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
